record.one_liner: Devin (Cognition) is an autonomous AI software engineer that takes tasks as sessions, works in repos, and opens PRs.
record.auth_notes: v3 API: service user credentials (cog_ prefix) sent as Bearer token, org- or enterprise-scoped, with RBAC roles and expiry (7/30/90 days, or never where allowed). Personal access tokens are also supported (enterprise PATs are governed by a policy that is disabled by default). Legacy personal API keys (apk_) are used by deprecated v1/v2. No OAuth flow for third-party apps is documented.
record.access_notes: Service users are created in Settings > Devin API (org) or Enterprise settings. The docs I fetched do not say which plans include API access. Third-party pre-April-2026 sources say API was limited to Team/Enterprise. Cognition's April 2026 blog says plans are now Free, Pro, Max, Teams and Enterprise, but I did not fetch it. Current plan entitlement is unverified. The Enterprise API is documented as available to enterprise customers only. Check devin.ai pricing or try on a free account.
record.blocker: The plan tier that grants API access is unconfirmed, and it may be paid-only. The enterprise API requires an enterprise contract. Rate limits are not documented in the pages I fetched. Legacy v1/v2 are deprecated. No OAuth, so users must hand over service user keys.
